_doc: Units the old maps lack: today's provinces (Natural Earth admin-1) given to a new unit, by country (adm0_a3) or province (iso_3166_2). Borders are approximate at province level. Order matters: new keys come after the map's own keys, in this order (hist_overlay.py and hist-old.mjs). 'take' moves pieces of another unit whose centre lies in bbox [lon0, lat0, lon1, lat1]. 'labels' fixes a unit's label point.
